A key is a full decorated name or a unique prefix of one (e.g. `?use@ChestBlock@@`); the tool fails on a key that matches nothing. `gone` needs one of the plan's section 4 evidence kinds, written out in `evidence`; 'searched and not found' is `unknown`, never `gone`. Every verdict cites where its evidence is.
